snippet.title: Silly Polly Beast ► Summer Game Fest 2025 Trailer
snippet.description:
Embrace your inner demon or be consumed by it. Silly Polly Beast is the story of a girl who, by the will of fate, faced the beast, and in order to become free - she was forced to study its nature. A story-driven shooter with aggressive gunfights and terrifying monsters awaits you. How far can you go in the fight for your freedom? Coming very soon.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1598780/Silly_Polly_Beast/
